children.value: > Fact From Story: Epic Games will drag a tech giant into court, alleging that its mobile app store is an illegal monopoly.

> > Fact From Story: Google spent its 45 minutes attempting to explain that its dominance over the Android app market isn’t anything nefarious but simply the natural outcome of Google fiercely competing with the iPhone and its iOS App Store

> > > Fact From Story: Google will point out that not only does the Play Store compete with Apple’s App Store, which the Ninth Circuit ruling in the Apple case agreed upon, too, but Android also supports competitive app stores like Samsung’s Galaxy Store and Amazon’s Appstore.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies want to be seen as not abusing their power.
> > Fact From Story: Epic wants to break up Google’s alleged monopoly on Android app stores and payment methods, so developers aren’t stuck paying the “Google Tax” or passing

> > > Fact From Story: Epic will attempt to demonstrate that Google makes it hard for alternative app stores to succeed and reach consumers, noting that 90% of apps are still downloaded through Google Play.
> > > Fact From Story: Epic promised to “show that Google has closed off each and every other option” to the Play Store during this trial.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies will sue for a lot of money.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies will go to court to fight what they believe to be illegal practices.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A monopoly is illegal.
